name: task-management-board
description: Kanban board boilerplate: Next.js + Node + SQLite + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
